name: Slice 6: open material Silhouettes as documents, with their material graph and inspector

comments.text: Dean 2026-11-27: material Silhouettes can't be opened by double-click. Plan: material cards in the asset browser open on double-click; a material Silhouette's document has a Viewport tab (hierarchy with its root, the material sphere preview, an inspector of its values that edits root.calamus) and a Material Graph tab (the graph editor on material:<name>, with Create graph when it has none). SilhouetteFolderOf finds silhouettes/materials/<name> too.
